ADMIN PANEL STRUCTURE:
1. OVERVIEW: Central Command Center for Boss to manage Era's usage across all PCs.
2. FEATURES:
   - User Management: View all users, active status, usage duration.
   - Subscription Control: See Free, Paid, or Pro plans. Enable/Disable any user instantly.
   - Data Analytics: Real-time data feed on when and how Era is used.
3. USER SIDE: Era runs on user PCs with a unique ID, sending heartbeat & usage data to Admin Panel.
4. SECURITY: Boss (Admin) has sole power to block any User ID from accessing Era.
